legalCitations.description: Affidavits — requirements for affidavits in civil matters; must be sworn before an officer authorized to administer oaths
Michigan Notary Public Act — notary authority to administer oaths and take affidavits; notary must indicate county of commission and expiration date
Perjury — false statement in a judicial proceeding; for Michigan affidavits, the notary oath provides the sworn affirmation; a separate perjury statement is not required in the affidavit text

affidavitJurat:
Subscribed and sworn to before me this ___ day of _______________, 20___.


_________________________________
[Notary Name], Notary Public
_______________ County, State of Michigan

My commission expires: ___________

exhibitRules.instructions: Label exhibits sequentially (Exhibit A, Exhibit B, etc.) and attach a cover page identifying the exhibit letter and a brief description. Reference each exhibit in the body of the affidavit and attach exhibits at the end of the document.
